notes.title: Slices of Infinity 2: More Levels, More Pain! (+ Other Fixes)
notes.content:
[i][b][h1]Slices of Infinity 2[/h1][/b][/i]
Get ready to test your wits and your brain in this [b]2 chapter expansion[/b] that features never before seen mechanics like block chains and... wall climbing?!

These levels and mechanics were made possible with the game's built-in level editor system. If your the type to build fun and adventurous campaigns for people to enjoy, or build difficult kaizo levels that'll make people pull their hairs out, this is the ticket!

What are you waiting for? Go on and play with your hearts content and let your creativity shine!

[previewyoutube=yW-3fZiY4VU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h1]Slices of Infinity 1 [u]CHANGES[/u][/h1][/b]
In other news, we have made some QOL updates, balancing changes, and bug fixes to several levels in chapters F and G to stay consistent with the new additions of Slices of Infinity 2 and even out the difficulty curve.

------------------------------------LIST OF CHANGES--------------------------------------

ALL SNEAK PEEK LEVELS REMOVED

Made top Big Antenna unreachable without using the Timed-Door

notes.title: Slices of Infinity: New Official Mini-Campaign & Level Editor Updates are out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/b56106f3ec5df3d0d680bd702d35e3ee59f35b9f.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[b][h1]YO SNAILS![/h1][/b]

Are you ready for a shell-shocking update? 👀 Check out our [b]New Official Mini-Campaign & Level Editor Updates![/b]

[h2][b]♾️  Welcome to [i]"Slices of Infinity"[/i] ♾️ [/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=g0L17aL3XdI;full][/previewyoutube]

Prepare to embark on a mind-bending journey through our brand-new campaign, [i]"Slices of Infinity"[/i] , created by the one and only ACalebM! But how do you access this molluscan masterpiece? Don't worry, we've got you covered:
[previewyoutube=-pDCORY01y0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]🛠️ Level Editor 2.0 ⚒️ [/b][/h2]
Our beloved Level Editor is getting a overhaul! You've waited for it, you've wanted it: here it is! 

Here's a list of what changed:

[list]
[*] You can now choose level difficulty, level type, level icon, starting unlock state, and default level exit

[*] New level trigger! Place this near the edge of a screen or around any place where the player can win in order to change where the player goes!

[*] New player spawnpoint object! Select a level to change the spawn point of the player depending from which level they came from!

[*] Updated completion percentage code to match base game which may result in some silly but intended behavior

[*] Added squid emotion setting, replaces AI visibility

[*] Added edpathprefix launch parameter.

[*] Lasers now output power

[*] Smiley counter's max value is now determined by the actual amount of collectable smilies in the level

[*] You can now turn off smiley counter fanfare

[*] Fixed smiley counter invert power not working properly

[*] Added new drone icon

[*] Added the ability to disable ball nanobots

[*] Level editor overrides can now be done per theme, by adding -(THEME NAME) to the end of the file name. the exception to this is underwater, which instead of using -underwater uses -inv for compatability with older color schemes. Level editor color schemes all use level_editor_play_mode.txt's overrides before looking for the style specific ones

[*] Fixed a race condition with the snowman mafia and destructable walls

[*] Bubble TD enemies can be destroyed by basket balls

[*] Triggers are now wireable! Check the Activation Conditions property

[*] Reduced maximum concurrant door sounds to 3(from 5)

[*] Added a door shut sound cap (3)

[*] Replaced the music trigger with the scene trigger

[*] The scene trigger can currently change music and Squid's expression.

[*] Added missing squid angry expression

[*] Added global flags!

[*] Triggers power let through behavior has been updated. Now, only the most recently activated trigger of it's type lets power through(assuming it doesn't require power to activate)

[*] Added silent doors

[*] Added silent buttons

[*] Added filters for move tool and wire tool

[*] Implemented squid invisible/visible for the scene trigger

[*] Replaced Hello AI with the instrumental in the editor

[*] Stopped cash cows from being in sync

[*] Fixed a bug with triggers not fully resetting under specific circumstances

[*] Added Firewall

[*] Added auto-aim gun

[*] Added disco spotlight

[*] Added sign object

[*] Ball nanobots and FX scale with ball

[*] Added vertical flip to Clonelly

[*] Fixed a bug where how far underwater bullets went were still affected by difficulty in community levels

[*] Added "wire optional" icon to indicate objects where wiring is optional vs objects where wiring is required for function

[*] Added fire level icon

[*] Changed bubble respawn animation

[*] Moved player tool properties to the bottom

[*] Smilies now appear as presents/winter event variant in the winter style

[*] Level exits automatically generate glow just like in the base game!

[*] Added new "Damageable Enemies" and "Fire" collision options to player trigger

[*] Conveyor belt can be flipped with the scene trigger

[*] You can now change bubble respawn time

[*] Fixed a bug where the chip causes the camera to zoom out

[*] Chip now emits power when collected

[*] Added 2 more sign texts, "Important!" and "Exit"

[*] Fixed baby squid having the "wire optional" icon

[*] Bubble enemies now have their own icons on the TD screen

[*] Invalid files loading now crashes the game with an error message showing the file that caused the problem instead of just showing a message and allowing the game to contine

[*] Fixed a bug where the music would continue to speed up/slow down while paused

[*] Added infinite health to targets(set it to zero)

[*] Added scale on two different axis and color changing to decals.

[*] Moved and gates onto the same layer as anchors

[*] Added a new "clean" wall variant for both normal and brain walls

[*] Changed brain wall color in editor

[*] Allowed zoom up to 300

[*] Added help for difficulty block

[*] Speedrun timer dims in editor

[*] Fix crash from game opening too many color schemes
[/list]

We can't wait to see what exciting levels you'll come up with with these new tools at your disposal.

[h3]Thank you for all your continuous support and love. 🤗 [/h3]

[h2]Snail You Later!![/h2]

notes.title: Infinite - The Level Editor is coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/837636f3dc4fc02bff5ef382aee1952ced704a0a.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]🐌 "Will You Snail Infinite" - Free Level Editor Update Releasing Soon! 🐌[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Greetings, fellow snails![/h2]

We're on the brink of a monumental day for our community - The "Will You Snail Infinite" Level Editor Update is releasing in just 2 days! The time has come to unleash your creativity and make "Will You Snail" your very own playground.

[b]📅 Release Date & Time: 6th September 2023, 15:00 CEST (06:00 PDT / 09:00 EDT) [/b]

[b]📺 Live Stream Alert:[/b] Join us on the 6th of September 2023 at 17:00 CEST ( 08:00 PDT / 11:00 EDT) where we'll be showcasing some of the very first levels created by you! Tune in and share in the excitement: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nbJ6ajwDNqc] Watch the Stream Here! [/url]
[previewyoutube=nbJ6ajwDNqc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]🎮 What's in Store?[/b]
Dive into a world filled with endless possibilities! With the full-fledged level editor, Steam Workshop integration for sharing your masterpieces, new blocks, and innovative tools, you are in for a treat. Whether it's designing a challenging maze, a beautiful vista, or a quirky sandbox - the power is in your hands.

However, a gentle reminder: while we're over the moon with what we've accomplished with this free update, our team remains small and passionate. We've poured our hearts into this, but remember, it's not "Elden Ring." Adjust your expectations, but rest assured, there's a universe of fun waiting for you!
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/137e9c6985bba84fa4f4db4083da2dd445d16233.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Setting the Mood:[/b]
Imagine a world where the cunning AI, Squid, doesn't just predict your moves, but also encounters the ingenious levels designed by you. The tables have turned! Now, not only do you dodge AI-spawned traps but also face the creative genius of fellow players. The question remains - will Squid ever be able to outsmart the collective might of our community?

Huge props to @MissingTextureMan101 and @OmegaMetor from our community who've played a pivotal role in bringing this update to life. This is truly an update by the community, for the community.
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/b507133175f578a6b0b88192baa15d7f139a60f6.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[b]🧡 A Message from Jonas & the Snail Team:[/b]
Your unwavering love and support have been the backbone of this project. From the initial concept of "Will You Snail" to this massive update, our journey has been nothing short of incredible. And it's all thanks to you!

So, gear up for a rollercoaster of creativity, challenges, and sheer fun! Thank you for being a part of this journey, and we can't wait to see the magic you create.

[h3]Keep on snailing! 🐌[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Will You Snail? More like, Will You Create? Dive in and let's find out![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/33293dc971c6b96515bc87fe2896464cdd29e5bc.png[/img]

notes.title: Will You Snail? Infinite (September 6th, 2023)
notes.content:
[b]THE LEVEL EDITOR IS (finally :eyes:) COMING ON September 6th, 2023![/b]
[i]This is a massive free update, meaning that it is free for everybody who already owns the game.[/i]

[previewyoutube=LAGu0viWvms;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What to expect:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Full Level Editor!!!
[*] Steam Workshop for Sharing Creations!!!
[*] New Blocks!
[*] New Tools!
[/list]
Play campaigns created by other creators, challenge your friends to beat your toughest levels, and share all your creations with the world! Dive into a world full of possibilities and make the craziest, most fun, innovative, and painful levels you can think of!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/c6af91e6039101a6ef70020ca48f193e7aaee4dc.png[/img]

[b]BY THE COMMUNITY, FOR THE COMMUNITY[/b]

This update is, for the most part, brought to you by MissingTextureMan101 and OmegaMetor, two passionate modders from the "Will You Snail" community who took on the daunting task of finishing the level editor. So, by all definitions, this is an update by the community, for the community, and we are incredibly curious and excited to see what you will create!

At this point, a huge shout-out to the rest of the snail team as well! From our community manager Sacha to all of the people who are helping out with marketing and publishing behind the scenes, it is really fun to see what this little project grew into.

For the sake of managing your expectations: Keep in mind that we are still a tiny team, and this is a free update. We gave it our very best, but obviously, it's not going to be the next Elden Ring. Please make sure to adjust your expectations accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/02fede9879b43090daa3eab63f4183abf54d4044.png[/img]

Thank you so much for your support, love, and for sticking with us all the way. This wouldn't have happened without you guys!

Cheers,
Jonas & the Snail Team

For a limited time you'll have access to:
[b]- A 20 level Winter Campaign, made EXCLUSIVELY within the upcoming level editor!! So, you can see this as a sneek peak of what you'll be able to build :D
- A Wintery Hub Area, and Music Reworks

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Yo, fellow snails! 

This update is all about addressing some of the most common sources of frustration for new players. For example traps can no longer spawn out out of view and some unhealthy difficulty spikes in the lower two difficulty settings have been ironed out a bit. We got Steam trading cards now and tons of other little polish and quality of life improvements. Minor spoiler warning! If you haven't played the game already, better stop here.


[h1]Quality of Life:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The game has Steam trading cards now!
[*] Added F11 as fullscreen / windowed hotkey
[*] Destructible blocks now show clearer warning when dropping.
[*] In Tower Defense level you can see which enemies are coming up next now.
[*] TD turrets show their range when you stand next to them.
[*] Basketball shows a dotted aim assist line to make it easier to learn and master.
[*] Additional sound effects for puzzle levels
[*] Snowman mafia got more reliable speedrun strat
[*] Localization improved & updated
[/list]

[h1]Balancing changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Traps can no longer spawn offscreen!
[*] Conveyor Belt speed lowered from (8 / 6.66 / 5.33 / 4) to (8 / 6 / 4 / 2)
[*] Overall amount of trap spawns reduced from (130% / 100% / 70% / 40%) to (130% / 100% / 66% / 33%)
[*] Reduced spike spawns in some early levels on the lowest two difficulties by an additional 25% (extremely easy) and 50% (infinitely easy)
[*] A16 spike probability increased by 50%
[*] First boss movement speed decreased from (125% / 100% / 75% / 50%) to (125% / 100% / 70% / 40%)
[*] Dance mini-game gives an additional grace period of 0.33 sec on infinitely easy and 0.16 sec on extremely easy for you to press a button.
[*] In laser room there will always at least be one laser active at a time. On lowest difficulty you can no longer get lucky by not having a single laser spawn.
[*] Disco Boss HP lowered from (800 / 800 / 800 / 800) to (800 / 800 / 700 / 600)
[*] When underwater your guns have about 20% and 40% longer range on the lower two difficulties.
[*] Mama Squid HP increased from (900 / 750 / 600 / 450) to (900 / 750 / 750 / 750)
[*] Your snail glow disappears while shelly is near Mama Squid's ink.
[*] The core in tower defense levels can take a few small hits before breaking.
[*] After re-enableing a turret in a TD level it has a 10 sec protection against being deactivated by an enemy.
[*] TD Jammers have a 5 sec cooldown after disabling a turret.
[*] Helpy starts out with (150% / 140% / 130% / 120%) battery charging speed but every time he charges, he loses charging speed all the way down to 50%. This stops the fight from going on indefinitely.
[*] Dronelly HP reduced from (2500 / 2000 / 1500 / 1000) to (2500 / 1500 / 1250 / 1000)
[*] Dronelly heat seeking missile speed reduced from (1 / 0.75 / 0.5 / 0.25) to (1 / 0.65 / 0.45 / 0.25)
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] There was a bug that allowed you to glitch into the next level while going back to level select. This is fixed now.
[*] Due to a bug Squid was way more talkative than he was supposed to. This is resolved now. No worries, he still talks more than enough.
[*] Basketball softlock fixed (again)
[/list]

Join us on Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/willyousnail]https://discord.com/invite/willyousnail[/url]

Hope you enjoy! Snail on!
Jonas :)

Dance mini-game gives an additional grace period of 0.33 sec on infinitely easy and 0.16 sec on extremely easy for you to press a button.
In laser room there will always at least be one laser active at a time. On lowest difficulty you can no longer get lucky by not having a single laser spawn.
Disco Boss HP lowered from (800 / 800 / 800 / 800) to (800 / 800 / 700 / 600)
When underwater your guns have about 20% and 40% longer range on the lower two difficulties.
Mama Squid HP increased from (900 / 750 / 600 / 450) to (900 / 750 / 750 / 750)
Your snail glow disappears while shelly is near Mama Squid's ink.
The core in tower defense levels can take a few small hits before breaking.
After re-enableing a turret in a TD level it has a 10 sec protection against being deactivated by an enemy.
TD Jammers have a 5 sec cooldown after disabling a turret.
Helpy starts out with (150% / 140% / 130% / 120%) battery charging speed but every time he charges, he loses charging speed all the way down to 50%. This stops the fight from going on indefinitely.
Dronelly heat seeking missile speed reduced from (1 / 0.75 / 0.5 / 0.25) to (1 / 0.65 / 0.45 / 0.25)

tags.bug: There was a bug that allowed you to glitch into the next level while going back to level select. This is fixed now.
Due to a bug Squid was way more talkative than he was supposed to. This is resolved now. No worries, he still talks more than enough.

notes.title: Patch 1.21
notes.content:
Hey, the first little patch is out! :)

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
➤ I created some cool Will You Snail themed Steam profile pictures for you. Check them out in profile / edit profile / avatar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35367160/6f370f2303e7532fdbc831244ce2947e252c60d1.png[/img]

➤ Reworked save / load system for better stability and redundancy. The already super rare save file wipes should be even rarer if not impossible now. Also remember that if you accidentally delete your save file in the save file selection, it's never truly deleted. You can always recover it from the save file directory on your PC.

➤ Reworked the look of conveyor belts to make it easier to see which direction they're currently moving in.

➤ Updated text translations. Various small improvements and additions for many languages.

➤ Images in the [spoiler]secret presentation room[/spoiler] are automatically scaled to the correct size so you don't need to resize them manually anymore.

➤ If there happens to be a loading delay for any of the voice lines, the subtitle should no longer show up way too early.

➤ Removed two soft-locks where players could get stuck. One in [spoiler]the disco boss fight[/spoiler] and one in [spoiler]a basketball level where the player could end up in a hole to high to jump out of.[/spoiler] 

[h1]For Modding:[/h1]
➤ I added a new branch that was not complied using YYC. You can reach it by right clicking on the game in your library / properties / betas / select "sandbox" branch. This version should be easier to decompile and modify. This branch might also help with stability in some cases if you're one of the few people struggling with game crashes. Curious to see what you create! :)

➤ I made a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yw9xDilCO2M]tutorial[/url] on how to recreate Squid's voice effect for those of you who are interested in making an audio language mod. :)

➤ Remember to check out the existing modding guides [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1115050/guides]here[/url].

[h1]Up next:[/h1]
For the next patches I plan to tackle more of your feedback to keep improving the experience, so keep it coming! Once the game is in a state we're all happy with, we can start thinking about adding more content. Join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/CJ2jkNG]Discord[/url] to stay up to date with the development and to participate in some fun community events! :)

Thanks so much for all the support! Snail on!
Jonas

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[h2]Finally, a new devlog![/h2]
[i]It's been over 9 months since the last update so there is a LOT to catch up on. Please let me know what you think about the new changes and have fun watching the video! :)[/i]

[previewyoutube=MaFpf3nmHmo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]What's New?[/h1]
Here is a quick summary of the video above:
[list]
[*] I added a bunch of new dialog snippets to the game that you have to find and try to make sense of. Now you can finally learn a lot more about Squid and the Will You Snail universe (if you want to).
[*] Squid has facial animations now.
[*] There is a new more chill game mode you can play for killing some time or relaxing a little.
[*] A bunch of new tracks were added to the soundtrack.
[*] The colors of the game were reworked (AGAIN). There are multiple color schemes you can choose from in the menu now.
[*] I made a ton of other little changes like adding save slots, polishing, but fixing, hiding some more secrets, and... and... and...
[*] Translating a game with so much text is a massive pain for a small indie developer like me. Due to my lack of experience I made some pretty silly legal mistakes that caused both me as well as a lot of translators to lose a ton of progress. Pretty stupid and upsetting. Let's hope I learned my lesson.
[*] I'm super nervous about launching the game cause my time and resource investments are just getting way out of control at this point. Making the game will cost me at least $20,000 and I already invested over 3 years into the development. To be completely honest, it's absolutely scary to think about. Yikes.
[*] The release date got moved to Q1 2022. That should give me more time to fix the remaining bugs and do some proper marketing. What are a few months after 3 years anyways... and what are a few more months after that anyways... and what are a few more months after that anyways... and what are a few more months after that anyways... and what are a few more months after that anyways... For real, though, whatever state the game might be in early next year, you'll all get to play it! It's set into stone.
[/list]

[h1]Join The Community[/h1]

A few other places where you can get more involved and follow the development of the game:

[h2]Discord[/h2]
There is already a fairly active and growing Will You Snail community on Discord. This is where we handle playtesting and community translations. A good place to hang out, ask questions and chat about the game.
Join here: https://discord.gg/G3mRDrK

[h2]YouTube[/h2]
I have a YouTube channel where I document the entire development process. The channel is also home to a bunch of other crazy game dev content (like generating infinite bathrooms) as well as a few tutorials. It's the best place to get a look behind the curtain and into my mind.
Subscribe here: https://www.youtube.com/jonastyroller

[h2]Twitter[/h2]
Here is where you'll likely find the most frequent updates. I use Twitter to get feedback, ask for your opinions, have a conversation and share my progress. It's the best place to get live updates on what's happening at all times.
Follow here: https://twitter.com/JonasTyroller

[h2]Reddit[/h2]
This one is not super active yet but I hope we can change that as we're getting closer and closer to launch. I love seeing your fan art and snaily memes. Looking forward to making more of those Reddit reaction videos for the YouTube channel. :P
Join here: https://www.reddit.com/r/WillYouSnail/

[b]This is a recent video of me checking out your snaily memes:[/b]
[previewyoutube=qZWFqvG76MA;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]THANKS FOR YOUR SUPPORT[/h1]

I want to thank you all very much for your support so far. It's absolutely insane how much you've already contributed to this game with your suggestions, testing, translations, motivation and mental support. This wouldn't be possible without you!! <3
